remarks: Your dream home just became available... welcome to 8 Twin Circle Drive, set on 1.4 +/- acres at the end of one of the two cul-de-sacs that comprise this beautiful enclave moments from Bedford Middle & Staples High Schools and the Wakeman ball fields and Town Farm. The picturesque, level property is park-like and serene, with gracious curb appeal. Upon entering, the airy, sun-filled interiors whisk you to a sophisticated oasis of comfort. High ceilings, oversized windows, hardwood floors and quality upgrades are found throughout this Colonial which is in fantastic condition. A bar with beverage chiller serves the living room for easy entertaining. The heart of this home is the gorgeous, remodeled open concept Great Room, where the kitchen, dining area and family room with fireplace all blend and become a hub waiting to be enjoyed. The kitchen w/ center island has stone counters, chef-grade appliances & custom cabinetry. The dining area has a built-in cabinet matching the tasteful decor of the space, as well as open shelving to display and enjoy treasured objects and design elements. With nearly a full wall of glass, the family room's French doors open to a wonderful patio. 4 BR w/ flex layout allows for main level guest/in-law suite. The luxe primary suite has an en-suite bath w/ double vanity, marble shower, soaking tub & a walk-in clst plus extra storage. The downstairs recreation room is a great bonus space. **FINAL OFFERS DUE MONDAY 3/17 11AM***
